resources.string: On-device AI · choose a document for cited facts
Experimental local AI. Replies can be wrong. General chat cannot read your vault or perform actions.
Answers use labelled English facts and exact source quotes from the document you choose.
What would you like to ask?
Type a message for the local model, or choose a document above to ask about its supported facts.
Chat stays in memory and clears when the vault locks. Only recent messages are used for context. Nothing is sent to a server.

This first document chat supports labelled policy and invoice fields, with page references. Missing or conflicting facts require clarification. It does not infer policy validity or provide a complete narrative summary.
Working on this device. A slow reply can take a few minutes. Cancellation may wait for native processing to return.
Set up the compact local model for general chat. Document facts can be read without it.
Changing the source starts a new chat so documents and previous replies stay separate.
Import a document first to ask about its facts.
